content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 24 vacancies are available – 6 for High Court of Judicature at Patna, 5 for CAT - Patna Bench, 6 for EI Court, 5 for Civil Court Patna, and 2 for Civil Court all Districts of Bihar (Except Patna).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.esic.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Advocate posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for ESIC Advocate posts is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Advocate post in ESIC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for the Advocate post in ESIC across various locations in Bihar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the ESIC Advocate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be registered with the Bar Council of India or a State Bar Council to be eligible for the Advocate position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for ESIC Advocate recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for ESIC Advocate posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ESIC Advocate posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the ESIC Advocate position?
faq.answer: The job type for the ESIC Advocate position is contractual.

faq.question: Q7. Which locations are covered under this ESIC Advocate recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers locations in Patna, including the High Court, CAT Patna Bench, EI Court, Civil Court Patna, and other Civil Courts in Bihar districts (excluding Patna).

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for ESIC Advocate recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the ESIC website. A link will be provided in the "Important Links" section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ESIC Advocate posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves empanelment based on the eligibility criteria and verification of documents.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Bihar apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The vacancies are primarily for Bihar, with specific mention of Civil Courts in districts of Bihar. Interested candidates should check the official notification for detailed eligibility regarding domicile.
